tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Describe this MCP server: which product it answers for, which repositories back it, and how fresh the underlying code index is. Instant (no AI). Call it once at the start of a session to confirm you are talking to the right product — if the index is stale or still building, say so instead of trustin

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "ask_product_expert" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "ask_product_expert" is 1712 chars, far longer than this server's median (339). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Tool "ask_product_expert" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
